repeater_frequency.description: Snapshot of the repeater frequency (MHz) at request time.

repeater_input_tone.description: Snapshot of the repeater input (RX) tone at request time.

repeater_output_tone.description: Snapshot of the repeater output (TX) tone at request time.

owner_id.description: User id of the repeater owner (created_by_id or owner_user_id). Used for RLS and dashboard lookups.

licensee_name.description: Full licensee name as entered by the requester.

family_members.description: Family members covered by the request, as entered by the requester.

message.description: Additional notes the requester included when asking for access.

owner_message.description: Optional response note the owner writes when granting or denying access.

description.description: Optional free-form note describing this access request.
